text: I'll check the workspace for the recruiter email so the reply matches it.Thank you for thinking of me and for sharing the details of the role. After reviewing the offer, the salary is below what I am looking for, so I will need to decline at this time. I enjoyed learning about the opportunity and would be glad to stay in touch. Please keep me in mind for future roles that may be a closer fit.
